title: Getting started at gemini.google.com

body.text: The website gemini.google.com is the main place to use Gemini, with
a simple chat screen plus a sidebar for your conversation history
. It's free with a Google account — just start typing your question right away.

example: "Go to gemini.google.com and type: 'What's the weather in Bangkok today?'"

title: Conversation modes in Gemini

body.text: Gemini supports several modes — typing text, uploading files, and using voice — with
a microphone button for talking and an attachment button for files

example: "Tap the microphone icon and say: 'Recommend some restaurants near me.'"
